(MTS-006) Gate release on CI: either convert release.yml to `on: workflow_run: { workflows: [Check], types: [completed], branches: [main] }` with `if: github.event.workflow_run.conclusion == 'success'` (checking out `github.event.workflow_run.head_sha`), or add a `check` job to release.yml that runs `pnpm check` and make `release` `needs: check`. Post-1.0 rule: one-minor deprecation window using JSDoc `@deprecated` + a one-time `Effect.logWarning` at Layer build for runtime-visible deprecations, removal in next major.

Summarize the policy in CONTRIBUTING.md under 'Commit and changeset conventions' and link the ADR.
